paper_title: Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs
caption: Distribution of deceived conversations across scenarios.
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the distribution of deceived conversations across various scenarios, including Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism. The horizontal axis lists these scenarios, while the vertical axis represents the Number of Conversations, marked in increments of 10 up to 60, with a linear scale and no units provided. Each scenario has three bars, colored red, yellow, and green, corresponding to "Yes", "Partially", and "No" deception, respectively. The Academic Funding scenario has the tallest red bar, at approximately 65, and the Journalism scenario has a yellow bar that is roughly 45 units long. The shortest green bars are found in Academic Funding and Academic Collaboration, each measuring around 5 units. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
